items.notes: OAuth refresh token; rotates in use, so neither copy may blindly overwrite a newer other copy. Contents never printed or logged.

Capture takes the canonical file whenever it exists, except an empty {} never overwrites a non-empty mirror (a colab run emptied this file while its assignment lived on, 2026-10-29). A restored file is stale until colab sessions/status validates it; dead sessions are pruned by the runner's orphan sweep, never trusted blindly. Contains a short-lived tunnel token: treat as secret, never print.
Only present when a custom client OAuth config is used.

Dedicated colab ssh key only (Ed25519/ECDSA). The ~/.ssh/config block for it is restored by marker-delimited append-merge in bootstrap, never by overwriting the file. Enable this item when colab ssh is first used.
Not file-mirrored. Recreated by uv tool install from the pin when missing or below min_version.
